QuestionStmt.S: Which from following reagents is used in Gattermann-Koch formylation of arene?

Solution.S: The Gattermann-Koch formylation is used to introduce a formyl group ($-\mathrm{CHO}$) onto an aromatic ring. The reaction requires carbon monoxide ($\mathrm{CO}$) and hydrogen chloride ($\mathrm{HCl}$) in the presence of anhydrous aluminium chloride ($\mathrm{AlCl_3}$) as a catalyst. Thus the correct reagents are CO, HCl, and anhydrous $\mathrm{AlCl_3}$, which corresponds to option B.
